learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with a thorough understanding of the principles of energy conservation, applied thermodynamics, and the analysis of the main thermal power systems, enabling them to apply these concepts in a wide range of operational scenarios.
Apply these tools for the characterization and preliminary design of machines and engineering systems.
Encompass the distinctive focus of the course, namely the study of machines and systems in biomedical engineering contexts.
Apply the aforementioned knowledge to biomedical environments, which require a fundamental understanding of physiological and anatomical principles.

syllabus_topics: Principles of conservation of mass, momentum, and energy applied to closed and open systems in steady-state form
Main thermodynamic transformations: isothermal, adiabatic isentropic, and polytropic processes, compression and expansion
Exchange and work mechanisms in fluid machines
Mechanical ventilators and mathematical models for pulmonary mechanics
Hyperbaric chambers and hyperbaric oxygen therapy
Principles of hyperbaric oxygen therapy and its applications
Pressurization circuits and ambient air supply in hyperbaric chambers
Compressors used in oxygen therapy: piston compressors, diaphragm compressors, vane compressors, screw compressors, and centrifugal compressors
Various types of vacuum pumps: vane pumps, oscillating piston pumps, gear pumps, fluid motor pumps, and liquid ring pumps
Machines for extracorporeal circulation and dialysis
Physiology of the heart, lungs, and cardiovascular system
Heart-lung machine and its components: centrifugal and roller pumps, heat exchangers, and filters
Anatomy and physiology of the kidney
Principles and functioning of dialysis, including the urea model
Pumps used in dialysis: peristaltic pumps (rotary and linear), piston pumps, syringe pumps
Infusion pumps: drop-controlled infusion pumps, rotary, linear, and piston peristaltic pumps, and pumps for infusing liquids containing drugs
Dental machines: types and sizing criteria of dental turbines
Techniques for the creation of sterile areas in industrial and hospital settings
bibliography: course notes and organized educational material
